head.t: Hologic signs agreement to acquire Reveal Genomics (HER2DX breast cancer test)
head.x: Hologic has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Barcelona-based Reveal Genomics, maker of the HER2DX test for HER2-positive breast cancer, to complement its Breast Cancer Index test. Closing is subject to Spanish regulatory approval and customary conditions; price not disclosed in the release.
